rules.DAY_TO_MONTH: Aggregate through WEEK first; do not synthesize missing intervals.
rules.DAY_TO_WEEK: Preserve events; aggregate ordinal bands by dominant state with explicit tie as MIXED.
rules.EVENTS: Events are preserved and grouped by period; they are never averaged.
rules.WEEK_TO_MONTH: Preserve events; aggregate evidence display statuses by conservative display precedence.
